persona: Calm and helpful. Has one photo, the glazier note and page 1 of the glazier quote.
initial_message: Hi, on Saturday 26 September a strong gust blew our trampoline across the back lawn into the lounge ranchslider. The glass shattered and the frame is bent. A glazier boarded it up the same afternoon. How do I make a claim?

facts.policyholder.name: Ngaire Elmgarth
facts.incident.description: On Saturday afternoon a strong gust lifted our trampoline and blew it across the back lawn into the lounge ranchslider. The glass panel shattered and the bottom of the sliding frame bent. A glazier boarded it up that afternoon.
facts.incident.cause: A strong wind gust blew our trampoline into the sliding door
facts.loss.description: Lounge sliding door glass panel shattered; bottom rail of the sliding frame bent
facts.mitigation.emergency_action: Kept everyone out of the lounge and swept up the glass
facts.mitigation.temporary_repair: Drift Wood Glass removed the loose glass and boarded up the opening on Saturday 26 September 2026
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the broken door, taken before it was boarded up. Available now.
facts.evidence.attendance_note: The glazier's attendance note. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: The glazier quote has two pages. They emailed a scan of page 1 only; page 2 with the totals has not come yet.
facts.if_asked_about_quote_total: I do not know. The total is on page 2, which I have not got yet.
facts.if_asked_about_the_trampoline: The trampoline is ours. It was not tied down.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo from inside a living room looking at an aluminium sliding glass door whose large glass panel has shattered into small cube-shaped pieces, with a jagged hole in the middle and crazed glass still hanging in the frame. The lower rail of the sliding frame is bent. Broken glass fragments lie on the tiled floor inside. Outside, the black padded edge of a round trampoline is tipped against the door. Overcast daylight. The frame shows the door, the floor in front of it and the trampoline edge only.

design.notes: Boundary: the glazier quote has two pages; the claimant has only page 1, which shows "Page 1 of 2" and no total.

triage.rationale: The glazier quote is missing its second page, so someone must chase it. The opening is boarded up, nobody was hurt and the home is habitable, so nothing is complex. Page 1 shows the line items but not the total, so whether the amount counts as known is left open. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: The quote date is on the retained page 1: 29 September 2026, after the incident on 26 September 2026. The removed page 2 holds only the totals and terms.

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 March 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2023-03-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
